submission.comment: Best strategy found: mean_reversion with lookback=82, entry_z=0.59, long_only=false, vol_target=false. Achieved Sharpe of 0.923 (annual return 58.4%, vol 63.3%, max DD 63.9%). Tested 645 strategies across all families. While no strategy exceeded Sharpe 1.0, this mean_reversion configuration was the highest, benefiting from frequent mean-reverting trades (69% time in market, 11% daily turnover) with moderate drawdowns.
